title: `oneOf` / `anyOf`
description: A parameter that accepts one of several shapes, using JSON Schema 2020-12 combinators.
question: Do both union combinators survive to each capture boundary?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Collapse would silently narrow what the agent is able to express.

notes.crewai: CrewAI: `destination.anyOf` survives, while `mode.oneOf` is collapsed by the generated `args_schema`; the combined capability is therefore only partly preserved.
notes.llamaindex: LlamaIndex (llama-index-tools-mcp 0.6.0): `McpToolSpec` rebuilds each `inputSchema` as a Pydantic model (`create_model_from_json_schema`), and the model's JSON schema is what `ToolMetadata.to_openai_tool` hands the LLM. A `oneOf` becomes the `anyOf` of a Pydantic union, and an object branch loses its properties.
notes.google_adk_js: Google ADK (TypeScript) 2.2.1: `MCPTool._getDeclaration` passes `inputSchema` through `toGeminiSchema`, which keeps `type`, `description`, `enum`, `items`, `properties`, `required` and `anyOf` in the genai `Schema` dialect. `anyOf` survives, but `oneOf` has no case: `deliver_payload.mode` arrives as `type: TYPE_UNSPECIFIED` with its description and no branches.
notes.smolagents: smolagents 1.26.0 (mcpadapt 0.1.20): `smolagents.models.get_tool_json_schema` rewrites an `anyOf` as a list of its branches' `type`s, so `destination` becomes `type: ["string", "object"]` and the object branch loses its properties. `mode.oneOf` survives, with `type: "string"` added beside it.
notes.crewai-native: CrewAI 1.15.26, native `crewai.mcp` client (`Agent(mcps=[...])`, not the `crewai_tools.MCPServerAdapter` row): `convert_tools_to_openai_schema` emits the strict OpenAI function schema from the Pydantic `args_schema`, which rewrites `mode.oneOf` as an `anyOf` of `const` branches plus `null`. `destination.anyOf` survives as `anyOf`.
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: `McpToolProvider` maps each `inputSchema` into LangChain4j's own `JsonSchemaElement` model (`JsonObjectSchema`, `JsonStringSchema`, `JsonIntegerSchema`, ...), and the `ToolSpecification` AiServices hands the `ChatModel` is built from that model. `anyOf` maps to `JsonAnyOfSchema` and survives. The model has no `oneOf`, so `deliver_payload.mode` becomes an empty `{"type": "object", "properties": {}}` and its alternatives are lost.
notes.koog: Koog 1.3.0-beta: no `anyOf` or `oneOf` reaches the model. The fixture's only `anyOf`/`oneOf` tool is `deliver_payload`, and `McpToolRegistryProvider.fromClient` leaves it out of the registry: `DefaultMcpToolDescriptorParser.parse` throws `IllegalArgumentException: Parameter Delivery mode. must have type property.` on its typeless `oneOf`, and `fromClient` only logs it.

summary: A framework that regenerates the schema can preserve `anyOf` while collapsing `oneOf`.
